comparison.title: Why Choose Archeris.net?
comparison.subtitle: How we compare with traditional solutions like Ianseo
comparison.description: Archeris is built from the ground up to modernize event management and scoring, bringing a modern cloud-native approach to archery tournaments.
comparison.f1_archeris: Cloud-native, 100% web-based. No installation required. Access anywhere.
comparison.f1_ianseo: Offline/desktop application. Requires local database (MySQL) and manual installation.
comparison.f2_archeris: Integrated online registration and payment gateways (QRIS, VA, credit cards).
comparison.f2_ianseo: Manual payment collection. Registrations are usually handled via external spreadsheets/forms.
comparison.f3_archeris: Pay per event and only for what you use. Flexible pricing that fits small to large tournaments.
comparison.f3_ianseo: Primarily offline tooling; payments, billing, and revenue tracking require additional manual steps.
comparison.f4_archeris: Real-time dashboards for participants, seeding, and brackets with easy sharing via links.
comparison.f4_ianseo: Strong printouts and on-site views, but sharing usually requires exporting files or local setups.
comparison.f5_archeris: Focuses on archer management and registration, removing unused/complicated modules to stay fast and simple.
comparison.f5_ianseo: Very feature-rich tournament suite with many advanced modules that can be complex to operate.
comparison.f6_archeris: Keeps registration simple; accreditation/badge workflows can be streamlined or handled with lightweight templates.
comparison.f6_ianseo: Built-in accreditation process, badge printing, and related printout workflows.
comparison.f7_archeris: Cloud-first operations with organizer dashboard, live status, and centralized management across locations.
comparison.f7_ianseo: Includes on-site tools like scheduling, TV output, spotting, and speaker views (often tied to local network setups).
comparison.f8_archeris: Public event pages with clear schedules, categories, fees, locations, and shareable links for participants.
comparison.f8_ianseo: Information is usually shared via printouts, exports, or on-site displays; public web sharing requires extra steps.
comparison.f9_archeris: Centralized division/category setup with cleaner UI and fewer settings to reduce organizer errors.
comparison.f9_ianseo: Highly configurable tournament setup with many options that can be complex to manage.
comparison.f10_archeris: Scorekeepers can download a mobile app for fast on-field scoring and real-time sync.
comparison.f10_ianseo: Scoring is primarily managed on desktop/on-site setups; mobile workflows depend on local configuration.
comparison.f11_archeris: Track registration/payment/check-in status with simple, organizer-friendly status controls.
comparison.f11_ianseo: Supports accreditation and participant states, but workflows can be heavier and more procedural.
comparison.f12_archeris: Manage participants with online forms, validation, payments, and bulk actions from one dashboard.
comparison.f12_ianseo: Strong participant management features with extensive printouts and on-site workflows.
comparison.f13_archeris: Automated target assignment by session/category with quick edits and live updates.
comparison.f13_ianseo: Advanced target assignment and scheduling features with many configuration options.
comparison.f14_archeris: Essential printouts (scoresheets, summaries) with clean templates and PDF downloads.
comparison.f14_ianseo: Very rich printout ecosystem (lists, statistics, accreditation, result sheets) tailored for on-site operations.

faqs_list.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan at any time?
faqs_list.answer: Absolutely! Flexibility is key. You can change plans whenever you like. Upgrades are calculated pro-rata for the remaining days of the billing cycle, while downgrades take effect in the next cycle.

faqs_list.question: What happens after the trial period ends?
faqs_list.answer: Your data remains safe on our servers. You will be asked to choose a paid plan to keep using premium features. If you don't choose in 7 days, your account will automatically return to the Free plan.

faqs_list.question: How does the payment model work?
faqs_list.answer: The EO plan uses a flat monthly subscription model. No per-athlete fees, allowing you to manage your tournament budget with absolute predictability.

faqs_list.question: How long does implementation take for the Elite plan?
faqs_list.answer: For Elite plans, we typically set up all custom configurations within 3-5 business days. You will also receive dedicated training sessions for your organizer's administrators.
